messages:
erin: Quick heads-up: noticed consistent token-latency drift on A100 with CUDA 12.3 after ~9k tokens in our streaming KV-cache jobs. Looks driver-related.

samir: Thanks Erin. Can you attach the minimal repro and logs? We'll open a partner escalation.

erin: Pushed small repro gist and logs to the ticket: https://tickets/redwood/PRJ-4602. Log sample shows kernel eviction and latency +30%.

jess_market: Marketplace pause request: please stop auto-promotion of images built on cuda-12.3. I'll add a pinned tag for GA (cuda-12.2-pinned) and a canary tag for experimental.

kevin_h: I'll schedule a nightly 10k-token smoke against the canary and capture Nsight traces. Alert if median token latency > baseline +20%.

ops-runner: Ops action: blocking autoscaler from launching nodes with runtime:cuda-12.3 in reserved pools, adding an infra gate to prevent accidental promotion.

samir: Opening partner case with NVIDIA, requesting prioritized driver hotfix or mitigation flags. Marked P1 and attached Nsight captures.

nvidia-bot: [auto] Case PRJ-4602 received. Eng-driver-team triaging.

erin: For now we should communicate to customers: "Temporarily pinning runtime images to CUDA 12.2 for production due to a performance issue on some A100 configs. Experimental images available for testing."

jess_market: Drafted marketplace note and changelog entry; holding broad release until vendor confirmation.

kevin_h: Once vendor provides a patch we'll validate in staging -> canary -> prod progression with rollback metrics defined.

samir: Action list summarized in ticket. Will post vendor replies here.
